scope: Completed existing-data publication analysis and draft; not a calibrated detector or particle-efficiency result.

native_equivalence.scope:
Numerically verified compiled execution of the unchanged publication protocol.

Only the EM inner loop is accelerated. Quantiles, initial seeds, all equations,
convergence criteria, PCA and the random draws are unchanged. This execution
extension is recorded separately from the already frozen statistical protocol.

figures.visual_review: All six final PNG canvases inspected; peak clipping, small markers, axis/title delimiter and label overlaps corrected. PDF/SVG use the same ROOT canvases; PDF bytes checked, not separately rasterized.

remaining_boundaries: Actual summing/load circuit, source geometry, temperature and calibration remain unconfirmed.
All check data previously explored; candidate selection and total model uncertainty are not in bootstrap intervals.
Local literature comparison does not establish global novelty or journal acceptance.
repository_actions: No commit or push in this stage; prior unrelated working-tree edits preserved.
